description: Known differences between a runtime's G2P output and phoneme_test_cases_golden.json (generated by Python). Each runtime's golden parity test fails when a case differs and is not listed here for that runtime, and also when a listed case starts to match, so fixed entries must be removed. status 'planned': the linked issue will fix it. status 'accepted': an exact match is not a goal (the reason says why); the entry stays until the output matches. Checked by scripts/check_g2p_known_divergences.py.

cpp.description: libpiper_plus C++ G2P (piper_plus_g2p_phonemize): C++ CLI, C API, Android AAR, iOS PiperPlus

rust.description: piper-plus-g2p MultilingualPhonemizer::phonemize_with_language, which piper-core uses when a language is given

swift.description: PiperPlusG2P (Swift) over the piper-plus-g2p C FFI, which reads text with MultilingualPhonemizer::phonemize_with_language over the handle's languages (Japanese text goes whole to the Japanese phonemizer)

go.description: Go phonemize.MultilingualPhonemizer.PhonemizeWithLanguage, which piperplus uses for WithLanguage / CLI --language

wasm.description: Browser npm piper-plus (src/wasm/openjtalk-web): JS EnglishG2P for en, the Rust WASM MultilingualPhonemizer for the other languages, compared as phoneme IDs

js-g2p.description: npm @piper-plus/g2p on its own (G2P.encode), the pure-JS G2P used when a model has neither ja nor zh

python_run.description: PyPI piper-plus runtime (src/python_run/piper_plus): the per-sentence phonemizer PiperVoice uses for a language ID

csharp.description: C# CLI text mode (PiperPlus.Cli TextModePhonemizer) with --language set to the case language: MultilingualPhonemizer with that language as the Latin default (zh also registers en), DotNetG2P.English for en, PiperPlus.Core for es, fr, pt, sv and zh
